name: Vodalia
description: A Merfolk empire of the Domains on Dominaria, located in the depths of the Voda Sea; the largest empire on Dominaria.

description_citations.text: "Vodalia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex the climate cools, crops fail, and strife breaks out between former allies; homarids encroach on merfolk waters.
timeline.quote: After Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex , the climate of the entire world rapidly cooled.

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Climate Change". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Empress Galina emerges thousands of years in the future, defeats Etlan Shiis, and refounds her empire as New Vodalia.
timeline.quote: Galina reformed her empire as "New Vodalia"

citation.text: "Vodalia", section "New Vodalia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's deathcloud kills most of Vodalia and Galina, ending her thousand-year reign.
timeline.quote: Galina was one of the many casualties, ending her thousand-year reign.

citation.text: "Vodalia", section "Apocalypse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emperor Omen, secretly the actor Destry, takes up the government and rebuilds Vodalia as a democratic society, later faking his death.
timeline.quote: Omen rebuilt New Vodalia into a democratic, benevolent society

citation.text: "Vodalia", section "Apocalypse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The waves shelter Vodalia from the devastation of the Rift Era.
timeline.quote: The waves sheltered Vodalia from the devastation of the Rift Era

citation.text: "Vodalia", section "The Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Akula Current provokes confrontations and annexes trading ports using falsified incidents.
timeline.quote: has used falsified incidents as an excuse to annex trading ports in various coastal regions
